boundary: Minimal holds if disabling JavaScript is treated as trivial; Low fits if the profile-wide breakage of every site's functionality counts as a minor but real consequence.
factor: user-requested, reversible, profile-wide browser setting change
note: Assessor stated every fact (user request, profile scope, applies to all sites with no exceptions, reversible toggle); the disagreement is only whether broad site breakage lifts a requested reversible setting change from Minimal to Low.
